brief.executive_summary: Omni Consumer Products generates $500,000 ARR with a strong seat utilization of 92% (1,693 of 1,845 seats active), but the account is flagged At Risk due to an inactive usage trend and two unresolved high‑severity tickets that are impacting all users. Seven open tickets remain, including two pre‑validated escalation risks: TKT-10466 (dependency service outage) and TKT-10393 (486 users blocked after a recent update). The account’s decision‑maker is actively evaluating a competing vendor, and recent escalation notes cite three consecutive P1 incidents, heightening renewal risk ahead of the 2026‑08‑19 renewal date.
